    • save

      @NonNull public abstract @NonNull Book save(@NonNull @NonNull Book book)
      Description copied from interface: CrudRepository
      Saves the given valid entity, returning a possibly new entity representing the saved state.

      If the entity has no identity value, an insert is performed. If the entity has a generated or always auto-populated identity value already present, an update is attempted. Entities with non-generated assigned identities are inserted by default. To require a specific operation, use CrudRepository.insert(Object) or CrudRepository.update(Object). This is the default repository save behavior and can be overridden by Micronaut Data configuration.

      Specified by:
      save in interface CrudRepository<Book,Long>
      Specified by:
      save in interface SimpleBookRepository
      Parameters:
      book - The entity to save. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The saved entity will never be null.
